text: You look stressed, Minh. What's wrong?
I have too much homework and too many tests. I feel a lot of pressure from my parents and teachers.
Have you talked to your parents about it?
Not yet. I'm worried they will be disappointed.
I think you should tell them. They can help you make a study plan.
You're right. I also spend too much time on my smartphone. I often check my social media accounts late at night.
That's bad for your health. You should turn off your phone before bedtime.
Thanks, Mai. I'll try. How do you deal with stress?
I usually participate in school club activities or play sports. It helps me focus and relax.
